# `oracle` source.json fields

Generated from [`drivers/oracle/resources/spec.json`](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/blob/v1.1.2/drivers/oracle/resources/spec.json) at `v1.1.2`. The same schema prints with `docker run --rm olakego/source-oracle:v1.1.2 spec`.
